title: Synthetic_Data_Generator
summary: A standalone Python script that generates synthetic interest-rate derivative trade data (trade dates, maturities, curve terms) using a fitted tabular synthesizer. It uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit on a sample dataframe and sample 100 synthetic rows.
evidence: SDV_Synthetic_Data.py:114 'synth = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)' followed by synth.fit(df) and synth.sample(100)
